question: What ritual fruit is obtained without doubt, O goddess?
premises: One obtains the fruit of a hundred-thousand-seat ritual
There is no doubt in this matter
inference: The practitioner certainly obtains the fruit equivalent to performing a hundred-thousand-seat ritual.
uncertainties: lakṣapīṭha may refer to a specific ritual installation or a large count of recitations
plain_english: O goddess, one obtains the fruit of a hundred-thousand-seat ritual; there is no doubt about this.
